---
title: "Directionality Assessment: AGES vs ADNI CSF pTau"
params:
  quartile_cutoff: 0.95
---

## Overview

This analysis assesses whether DNA methylation effect directions are consistent between AGES dementia associations and CSF phosphorylated tau associations in cognitively normal subjects using binomial sign tests.

```{r}
#| label: load-packages
#| echo: false

# Additional packages (tidyverse, here, janitor, glue loaded via .Rprofile)
pacman::p_load(scales, install = FALSE)

conflicted::conflict_prefer_all("dplyr", quiet = TRUE)

source(here("custom_func/display_scientific_notation.R"))
```

```{r}
#| label: load-data

facet_data <- read_rds(here("validation/output/facet_data_pre_filter_CSF_pTau_CN.rds"))
```

```{r}
#| label: apply-quartile-filter

# Apply quartile filtering per sub-dataset (cutoff_value + demcat)
if (params$quartile_cutoff < 1) {
  lower_q <- (1 - params$quartile_cutoff) / 2
  upper_q <- 1 - lower_q

  facet_data <- facet_data |>
    mutate(
      x_lower = quantile(ages_effect_size, lower_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      x_upper = quantile(ages_effect_size, upper_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      y_lower = quantile(ptau_estimate, lower_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      y_upper = quantile(ptau_estimate, upper_q, na.rm = TRUE),
      .by = c(cutoff_value, demcat)
    ) |>
    filter(
      ages_effect_size >= x_lower & ages_effect_size <= x_upper,
      ptau_estimate >= y_lower & ptau_estimate <= y_upper
    ) |>
    select(-x_lower, -x_upper, -y_lower, -y_upper)
}
```

```{r}
#| label: prepare-directionality-data

directionality_data <- facet_data |>
  mutate(
    ages_direction = sign(ages_effect_size),
    adni_direction = sign(ptau_estimate),
    concordant = ages_direction == adni_direction & ages_direction != 0 & adni_direction != 0
  ) |>
  summarise(
    n_total = n(),
    n_concordant = sum(concordant, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_discordant = n_total - n_concordant,
    prop_concordant = n_concordant / n_total,
    .by = c(cutoff_value, demcat, pval_cutoff)
  )
```

The scatter plots in the main comparison document show that several CpGs have opposing effect directions between AGES and ADNI CSF pTau. To formally assess whether effect directions are more concordant than expected by chance, we perform binomial sign tests.

**Analysis parameters:** Quartile cutoff = `r params$quartile_cutoff`

## Binomial Sign Test

For each dementia category and significance threshold combination, we test whether the proportion of CpGs with concordant effect directions (both positive or both negative) is significantly greater than 50% (what would be expected by chance).

```{r}
#| label: binomial-sign-test

# Perform binomial sign test for each demcat x threshold combination
binomial_results <- directionality_data |>
  rowwise() |>
  mutate(
    binom_test = list(binom.test(n_concordant, n_total, p = 0.5, alternative = "greater")),
    ci_lower = binom_test$conf.int[1],
    ci_upper = binom_test$conf.int[2],
    binom_pval = binom_test$p.value
  ) |>
  ungroup() |>
  select(-binom_test) |>
  mutate(
    demcat = fct_relevel(demcat, "prev", "mci2incid", "normal2incid", "stable_mci", "normal2mci"),
    significance = case_when(
      binom_pval < 0.001 ~ "***",
      binom_pval < 0.01 ~ "**",
      binom_pval < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# Display summary table
binomial_results |>
  select(
    demcat, cutoff_value, n_total, n_concordant, n_discordant,
    prop_concordant, ci_lower, ci_upper, binom_pval, significance
  ) |>
  arrange(demcat, desc(cutoff_value)) |>
  mutate(
    prop_concordant = scales::percent(prop_concordant, accuracy = 0.1),
    ci_95 = glue("{scales::percent(ci_lower, accuracy = 0.1)} - {scales::percent(ci_upper, accuracy = 0.1)}"),
    binom_pval = display_scientific_notation(binom_pval)
  ) |>
  select(-ci_lower, -ci_upper) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Dementia Category", "Threshold (-log10)", "N Total", "N Concordant",
      "N Discordant", "% Concordant", "P-value", "Sig.", "95% CI"
    ),
    caption = "Binomial sign test results for effect direction concordance between AGES and ADNI CSF pTau"
  )
```

## Interpretation

A significant p-value (< 0.05) indicates that the proportion of CpGs with concordant effect directions is significantly greater than 50%, providing evidence that the AGES and ADNI CSF pTau studies show consistent effect directions beyond what would be expected by chance.

## Directionality Visualization

```{r}
#| label: fig-directionality-heatmap
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 6

# Create heatmap of concordance proportions
directionality_plot <- binomial_results |>
  mutate(
    threshold_label = glue("Threshold: {cutoff_value}"),
    threshold_label = fct_reorder(threshold_label, -cutoff_value),
    sig_label = glue("{scales::percent(prop_concordant, accuracy = 1)}{significance}")
  ) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = demcat, y = threshold_label, fill = prop_concordant)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_text(aes(label = sig_label), size = 3.5) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d73027",
    mid = "#ffffbf",
    high = "#1a9850",
    midpoint = 0.5,
    limits = c(0, 1),
    labels = scales::percent
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Dementia Category",
    y = "ADNI CSF pTau P-value Threshold",
    fill = "Proportion\nConcordant",
    title = "Effect Direction Concordance: AGES vs ADNI CSF pTau",
    subtitle = "Binomial sign test (* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001)"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

print(directionality_plot)
```

## Summary Statistics

```{r}
#| label: directionality-summary

# Overall summary across all thresholds
overall_summary <- binomial_results |>
  summarise(
    mean_concordance = mean(prop_concordant),
    min_concordance = min(prop_concordant),
    max_concordance = max(prop_concordant),
    n_significant = sum(binom_pval < 0.05),
    n_total_tests = n(),
    .by = demcat
  )

overall_summary |>
  mutate(
    across(c(mean_concordance, min_concordance, max_concordance), ~scales::percent(., accuracy = 0.1))
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Dementia Category", "Mean Concordance", "Min Concordance",
      "Max Concordance", "N Significant Tests", "N Total Tests"
    ),
    caption = "Summary of effect direction concordance across significance thresholds"
  )
```

## Export Figures

```{r}
#| label: save-figures

# Save directionality heatmap (png and rds)
ggsave(
  here("validation/output/fig_directionality_heatmap_CSF_pTau_CN.png"),
  directionality_plot,
  width = 10,
  height = 6,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white",
  device = ragg::agg_png
)
write_rds(directionality_plot, here("validation/output/fig_directionality_heatmap_CSF_pTau_CN.rds"))
write_rds(binomial_results, here("validation/output/directionality_results_CSF_pTau_CN.rds"))

message("Figures saved to validation/output/")
```
